Narrowed on 2026-09-14 after the earlier finding was corrected. Playwright is already pinned in the repository (root package.json "@playwright/test": "1.63.0", commit 2c88ed0 via PR #93; a clean npm ci installs it and ./node_modules/.bin/playwright reports 1.63.0 without a global CLI), and a per-module convention already exists (client/e2e/<module>/playwright.config.js with technical/uat projects and HARNESS_RESULT_PATH support, declared in the Business Master profile as business-master-browser and business-master-uat-browser). The single remaining question is when and by whom a CI job is added that actually runs the Playwright suites. It cannot be added today: the one existing suite is red on main (14 failed, 1 passed, the single pass being the unauthenticated-redirect case), so wiring it would turn main red. Repairing that suite belongs to the Business Master owner, and uncommitted work in its worktree may already address it. For this module the exposure is low until PHASE-002 creates the first Fulfillment UI, at which point client/e2e/fulfillment-shipping-management/ plus a matching profile suite and CI coverage must exist. Do NOT attach a Playwright tool_probe to fulfillment-technical, whose argv runs node --test server/test and has no browser step.
